why: Run L4 sub-run L4e's leftovers that no run L4 area takes: by design, rare, or for the final check.

items.text: A dependency merged on GitHub (not closed) shortly before the Merge press reads 'waiting for you to merge' until the watcher's next poll: settling it at the press would start the merge's listeners (copy refresh, card closing, rebuilds of other dependents) without the person's press.
After Undo of a take-over, the removed project's docs pull request stays open on GitHub; the next Take it over opens a second one (run C decision 14). The person could merge the wrong one.
rebuildForTakeOver writes the branch's version of every file the branch changed since its merge-base; if main later changed the same file, main's newer version is replaced.
Two concurrent first-plan POSTs are not refused atomically (pendingFor is checked before the model call).
The writing-rules possessive sweep only catches the `"${x}"'s` and `quoted(...)}'s` forms.
By specialist and By model of the kept project are empty for moved tasks after a join (the project's own ledger).
